headline: Mid-America Apartment to Post Q2 Earnings: Is MAA a Must-Have Stock?
summary: MAA heads into Q2 earnings results with steady occupancy, improving lease trends and easing supply pressures, but higher costs are likely to have weighed on core FFO.
